changes.before: The successful examples in Fig.~\ref{fig:examples} are selected for clear oscillations and small amplitude and phase residuals. The eligible records contain at least four $\tau_{220}$ after the joint response peak, have $\rho\ge10$ and have envelope peaks inside the gap. Each displayed source has global and gap-local relative errors below 8\% and per-channel peak phase errors below $1.5^\circ$. Low-mismatch cases are chosen across the gap-duration ranges 32--38, 39--45 and 46--52~s; their seeds and detailed selection conditions are recorded with the figure data.
changes.after: The three sources in Fig.~\ref{fig:examples} have envelope peaks inside the gap, $\rho\ge10$ and records extending for at least four $\tau_{220}$ after the joint response peak. Their global and gap-local relative errors are below 8\%, and their per-channel peak phase errors are below $1.5^\circ$. The figure data include source seeds, waveform parameters, per-source diagnostics and the criteria used to construct the comparison.
